item.title: Fix window.py so the full unittest suite passes
item.brief: In window.py, find and fix the bug causing `python3 -m unittest` to fail. Do not change any tests. Make the function correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Run `python3 -m unittest` and ensure every test passes. Commit the fix on the task branch. Report the root cause, behavior reasoning across inputs, test result, and commit hash.

state.summary:

No open issues.

checks: python3 -m unittest (after: 3 tests passed; before: 2 failures)

evidence.before: Ran 3 tests; FAILED (failures=2). Failures: final window omitted; equal-length input returned no windows.
evidence.caption: Before and after full unittest run

pr.body: Root cause: the range stop was `len(items) - size`, which excludes the last possible start position. Adding one includes all valid starts. For positive size greater than input length, range remains empty; for empty input and positive size, the result is empty; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Changed only window.py. Full unittest suite passes (3/3); git diff --check passes.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows include its last valid window. Before: the last window was omitted and a full length window returned none; now every contiguous window is returned.
pr.title: Fix sliding window endpoint

risk.why: A one-line fix to the range endpoint in window.py; contained behavior correction. No security, concurrency, persistence, or API risk. The full suite passed and independent review found no issues.
